answer: A Registered domain bound by in-person pickup code with a ninety-day rotation cooldown ties the identity to something the applicant actually controls: the registered domain answers a fresh challenge, the in-person pickup code is recorded, and a ninety-day rotation cooldown keeps one channel from spawning many identities, so a Sybil farm would need a separate real channel for every fake account. A lone beacon cannot fake a channel; only the bound record counts. The umber test catches the lazy fake and the ferrous test catches the patient one.
